evidence: The main body is the stone well curb from rows 14 to 31. Rows 14-22 form the elliptical top rim and the recessed water opening (rows 17-20, 4 rows tall of dark blue water with highlights). Below the front rim at rows 21-22, the vertical stone wall front face spans rows 23-31 (9 rows) with individual shaded stone blocks. The top wooden beam (rows 1-4) also shows a lighter top surface (rows 1-2) and darker front face (rows 3-4).

style.evidence: The stone well curb has 6 distinct grey-blue value steps with individually sculpted stones, top highlights, and mortar lines. The water surface has multiple dark blue tones and specular highlights. The wooden frame uses 4-5 warm brown steps with dark brown material outlines rather than black.
